title: COR2 — Édition numérique de la correspondance de Pierre Corneille
notes:
Pierre Corneille destroyed most of his correspondence; only about twenty letters survive ('la vingtaine de lettres qui demeurent', per the project page), so texts ≈ 20, approximate. Edition combines facsimile of the autograph, semi-diplomatic edition showing Corneille's own interventions (erasures, corrections), a modernised transcription, hypertext annotation and indexes, encoded in XML-TEI per the Cahier consortium guidelines; freely accessible on Huma-Num. Word count not stated. Small single-author correspondence, but a recognised scholarly edition of the surviving letters.

Justification: A freely accessible TEI-XML philological digital edition of the surviving 17th-century autograph letters of Pierre Corneille (within 1450–1700), with diplomatic and modernised views and scholarly apparatus; not in the catalogue. Found via a general French-language web search for 2026 digital edition projects on Huma-Num.
Found at: http://corneille-correspondance.huma-num.fr/cor2/projet.html
